description: Real data schema + representative mock data for every dashboard module in platform-console, derived from the actual TypeScript source in app/lib/*.ts -- not invented.

active-sessions.description: Real Active Session Management -- the AWS IAM Identity Center 'active sessions' view / GCP Console 'manage devices & activity' equivalent.

alerts.description: Server-side proxy to the real in-cluster Alertmanager deployed by the monitoring stack.

api-keys.description: Real hyperscaler-PaaS-style API key self-service (AWS IAM access keys / GCP service account keys / Stripe API keys equivalent).

prefix.description: shown in listings, never the full key

audit.description: Node.js-only durable persistence for the audit log -- the real hyperscaler CloudTrail / GCP Audit Logs / Azure Monitor Activity Log equivalent.

audit-export.route: not found (no page.tsx imports it directly; consumed via app/app/api/audit/export/route.ts)
audit-export.description: Real SIEM-format export for the durable audit trail -- the AWS CloudTrail 'S3/log export' / GCP Cloud Logging 'log sink export' equivalent.

schema.description: EcsAuditEvent -- Elastic Common Schema mapping of an AuditLogRow.

audit-log-entry.route: not found (underlies audit-db.ts and middleware.ts; not a standalone page)
audit-log-entry.description: The real, mechanical 'access is logged' control: one JSON line per authenticated request, written to stdout via console.log, in a fixed schema.

org-roles.description: Real application-level RBAC (AWS IAM Identity Center permission sets / GCP Org Policy / Azure AD role assignments equivalent), layered on top of -- never replacing -- the k8s-level RBAC the console's own ServiceAccount already has.

batch-jobs.description: Real hyperscaler-PaaS-style Batch Compute primitive (AWS Batch / GCP Batch / Azure Batch equivalent).

budget-alerts.description: Real Budget Alerts (AWS Budgets / GCP Billing Budgets equivalent): an operator sets one real threshold per namespace and gets a real, HMAC-SHA256-signed webhook the moment real measured usage genuinely crosses it.

currentValue.description: null only when the real Prometheus query failed

canary.description: Real Canary/Blue-Green deployment traffic control (AWS CodeDeploy traffic-shifting / GCP traffic-splitting / Azure deployment slots equivalent), built on Istio's real weighted VirtualService routing.

certificates.description: Real Certificate Lifecycle tracking: this module reads the same live Secrets the cluster's own Envoy/SDS layer already reads and parses each real certificate's real notAfter with Node's own crypto.X509Certificate.

container-exec.description: Container Exec: runs a fixed allowlist of harmless commands inside a real pod (no arbitrary shell).

custom-domains.description: Real Custom Domain self-service: an operator names a hostname and picks one of the platform's own real Services as the routing target.

dashboards.description: Real Custom Dashboards / Saved Queries: an operator saves a real query -- either PromQL or a filtered lookup against the real durable audit log.

functions.description: Server-side proxy to a project's real Supabase Edge Functions runtime (supabase/edge-runtime, started with --main-service).

global-search.route: not found (backs /api/search; results link out to /service-discovery, /projects/[name]/database, /secrets, /scheduled-jobs, /projects/[name]/backups, /webhooks)
global-search.description: Global Search / Command Palette: real cross-resource lookup, run live against the exact same lib functions every individual module already calls -- never a client-side static index.

gotrue-auth.description: Real, server-side calls to GoTrue's real end-user auth REST endpoints -- POST /signup and POST /token?grant_type=password -- against the live GoTrue (Supabase Auth) instance already running in this cluster.

project-auth.description: Server-side, read-only proxy to a project's real GoTrue (Supabase Auth) admin API.

iac.description: Real Infrastructure as Code export + drift detection primitives -- the AWS CloudFormation drift-detection / Terraform plan / GCP Deployment Manager equivalent for this console's own self-service Project+Database resources.

billing.description: Cost-preview calculation (AWS Cost Explorer 'forecasted bill' / GCP Billing cost-breakdown equivalent) computed over real metered Prometheus data.

service-discovery.description: Minimal Kubernetes API client using the pod's own in-cluster ServiceAccount token -- no external k8s client library, no fabricated client-side state. ServiceDiscoveryRecord is the merged Service+Endpoints view shown on /service-discovery.

projects.description: SupabaseProject -- the real self-service Project custom resource status shown on /projects.

ready.description: null when no Ready condition has been reported yet

iam.description: RbacRole, IamNetworkPolicy, IamPeerAuthentication -- real k8s RBAC/NetworkPolicy/Istio PeerAuthentication objects shown on /iam.

load-test.description: Real Load Testing / performance benchmarking self-service: fires real concurrent HTTP requests against one of the platform's own services and measures real p50/p95/p99 latency and real success/error counts.

migrations.description: Real self-service Database Schema Migrations: an operator submits a real versioned up/down SQL pair, applied inside a real Postgres transaction against that project's own live database.

mock_data.name: create_example_table
mock_data.upSql: CREATE TABLE example (id serial primary key);

network.description: Real hyperscaler-VPC-console-style Network Topology primitive: Pod/Service CIDR ranges, a per-namespace reachability matrix, and the Istio mTLS trust boundary, all in one place.

podCidr.method: authoritative (Node.spec.podCIDR), corroborated by observed live Pod IPs

serviceCidr.method: observed only (derived from live Service ClusterIPs)

oidc-federation.description: External OIDC federation -- the 'Sign in with Google/GitHub/Microsoft' pattern, layered alongside the local-admin path and the internal GoTrue identity-federation path.

policy.description: Real Policy-as-Code / Organization Policy surface (AWS Config Rules / GCP Org Policy equivalent) -- read-only.

observability.description: Server-side proxy to the real in-cluster Prometheus instance deployed by the monitoring stack.

quickstart.description: Generates the /quickstart page's personalized quickstart.sh: a real bash script that drives this exact deployment's real HTTP API with curl + jq -- the AWS CLI getting-started / gcloud init / Vercel CLI equivalent for this PaaS.

schema.description: QuickstartScriptInput -- output of buildQuickstartScript is a templated shell-script string, not structured dashboard data.

scheduled-jobs.description: Real hyperscaler-PaaS-style Scheduled Jobs primitive (AWS EventBridge Scheduler / GCP Cloud Scheduler / Azure Logic Apps recurring-trigger equivalent): self-service creation of real k8s batch/v1 CronJobs.

session.route: not found (server-only auth helper consumed by every page and API route to verify the session cookie)
session.description: Hand-rolled session handling using jose (HS256 JWT), edge-runtime safe so it can run inside middleware.ts without pulling in Node-only crypto APIs.

status-page.description: Real public status-page data: uptime% and current up/down state for every platform component, computed with genuine PromQL over the real up time series that services/platform-prober writes into the cluster's real Prometheus.

project-status.description: Server-side fetchers for each project's cluster-internal /status endpoint.

storage.description: Server-side, read-only proxy to a project's real Supabase Storage API (GET /bucket).

tags.description: Real hyperscaler-PaaS-style Resource Tagging / Organization primitive (AWS Resource Groups & Tag Editor / GCP Labels / Azure Tags equivalent): a key=value pair attached to a real platform resource, backed by genuine Kubernetes metadata.labels.

topology.description: Deterministic 2D layout for the Cluster Topology visualization.

vuln-scan.description: Real Container Vulnerability Scanning (AWS ECR image scanning / GCP Artifact Registry vulnerability scanning / Azure Defender for Containers equivalent). Runs the real, open-source trivy scanner.

webhooks.description: Real hyperscaler-PaaS-style Outbound Webhooks / Event Notifications primitive (AWS EventBridge / GCP Eventarc / Azure Event Grid equivalent): HMAC-SHA256-signed HTTP POST notifications on real platform events.
